study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Nature Mental Health, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: A multimodal neural signature of face processing in autism within the fusiform gyrus

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objectives, hypotheses, and the purpose of applying normative modeling. Specifically, it aims to understand the fusiform gyrus (FFG) in face processing in autism by integrating individual-level deviations across multiple imaging modalities and testing their clinical relevance.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In the present study, our aim was to provide a more comprehensive understanding of the FFG in face processing in autism by elucidating the simultaneous involvement and multivariate interplay of different neural sources... We combined two methodological innovations: (1) First, we employed normative modeling 49 on each imaging modality separately... (2) Next, we conducted multimodal fusion through linked independent component analysis (LICA)... We hypothesized that multimodal components... would differentiate autistic from nonautistic individuals and would be associated with core cognitive and clinical features.
cm1_research_objectives.location: Main text, Introduction and "In the present study" paragraph

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study builds a NEW normative model and describes the reference cohort (NAI) eligibility criteria, image quality standards, final sample size, and reasons for exclusion. The reference cohort was drawn from the LEAP project, and specific exclusion criteria (e.g., no psychiatric disorders, IQ > 50, MRI contraindications) are provided. Quantitative image quality metrics and motion thresholds are also specified.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Participants were part of the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP cohort... In the NAI group, parent or self-report of a psychiatric disorder was an exclusion criterion... Structural T1-weighted images with excessive head motion (N=37), clinically (mostly) non-significant atypicalities (N=21) and failed preprocessing (N=3) were excluded... Applying all exclusion criteria resulted in a sample of 204 individuals (99 autism, 105 nonautistic individuals [NAI]).
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.location: Main text, Methods; ESM, "Participants, study design and exclusion criteria"

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The study explicitly incorporates age, sex, and scanning site as covariates in the normative modeling. It also uses B-splines to model nonlinear effects of age.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: we trained normative models using Bayesian linear regression for each brain imaging modality within the right and left FFG region of interest (ROI) independently using age, sex and scanning site as covariates. A B-spline basis expansion of the covariate vector was used to model nonlinear effects of age.

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data source for the reference cohort is clearly specified as the EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Participants were part of the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP cohort.

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: The study uses primary data collection and provides detailed acquisition parameters (TR, TE, resolution, flip angle, etc.) and equipment specifications (manufacturers and models for multiple sites) for structural MRI, rs-fMRI, task-fMRI, and EEG.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: MRI data were acquired on 3T scanners: General Electric MR750... Siemens Magnetom Skyra... Siemens Magnetom Verio... Philips 3T Achieva... GE Medical Systems Signa HDxTt... and Siemens Magnetom Trio... T1-weighted images: ... TR=2300ms, TE=2.93ms, T1=900ms, voxels size=1.1x1.1x1.2mm... resting-state fMRI: ... TR=2300ms, TE~12ms, 31ms, and 48ms... [Details in Supplementary Tables 13 and 14].
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.location: ESM, "MRI and EEG data acquisition" and Supplementary Tables 13-14

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: The preprocessing steps, software used (SPM12, FSL, CAT12, EEGLab, FieldTrip), and quality control procedures (e.g., motion correction, segmentation, artifact removal) are described in detail for each imaging modality.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: Structural MRI data preprocessing: ... preprocessed using a voxel-based morphometry pipeline (VBM) based on the CAT12 package... in SPM12... Resting-state fMRI data preprocessing: ... preprocessed using a standard preprocessing pipeline that included tools from the FMRIB Software Library (FSL version 5.0.6)... ICA-AROMA... EEG preprocessing: ... Each dataset was first loaded into EEGLab... all task processing was carried out in the Matlab Fieldtrip toolbox.

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study uses a 10-fold cross-validation strategy to derive normative models in an unbiased manner.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: Normative models were derived in an unbiased manner across the entire sample under tenfold cross-validation.

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study does not apply the normative model to an independent external dataset of healthy individuals for validation; it relies on internal 10-fold cross-validation.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: Normative models were derived in an unbiased manner across the entire sample under tenfold cross-validation.

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical approach (Bayesian linear regression), model settings (B-splines for nonlinear age effects), and software (PCNtoolkit) are clearly described.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: we trained normative models using Bayesian linear regression 98 for each brain imaging modality... A B-spline basis expansion of the covariate vector was used to model nonlinear effects of age... Code is available at https://github.com/amarquand/PCNtoolkit.

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: Model performance is quantitatively assessed using Rho, explained variance (EV), MSLL, and SMSE, which are reported in the supplementary materials.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The accuracy of the normative model was evaluated using the correlation between the recorded and the predicted voxel values (Rho), mean standardized log loss, standardized mean squared error and the EV (Supplementary Fig. 1).
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.location: Main text, Methods; ESM, Supplementary Fig. 1

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: Although 10-fold cross-validation was used, the specific demographic characteristics (sample size, age, sex) for each of the 10 training/test partitions are not reported.
nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.supporting_text: Normative models were derived in an unbiased manner across the entire sample under tenfold cross-validation.

cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.reason: The clinical cohort eligibility (DSM diagnosis, ADI-R/ADOS confirmation), IQ threshold, and exclusion criteria are described. The final sample size (N=99) and exclusion reasons per modality are reported.
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: All autistic participants had an existing clinical diagnosis of autism... confirmed using the combined information of gold-standard diagnostic instruments, the ADI revised 55 and the ADOS 93,94... Individuals with an intelligence quotient (IQ) below 50 were excluded... For inclusion and exclusion criteria per modality, see Supplementary Methods and Extended Data Fig. 5.
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.location: Main text, Methods; ESM, "Participants, study design and exclusion criteria"

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: While basic demographics and site were handled in the normative model, clinical covariates like medication status were mentioned as inclusion criteria (must be stable) but not explicitly used as covariates in the analysis of deviation scores. Handedness was controlled for in sensitivity analyses.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: Individuals were included if they were on stable medication (at least 8 weeks)... Results remained unchanged when additionally controlling for handedness.

cr3_data_sources_clinical_cohort.reason: The clinical cohort data source is the EU-AIMS LEAP project, same as the reference cohort.
cr3_data_sources_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: Participants were part of the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP cohort.

cr4_clinical_characteristics_clinical_co.reason: Sample size, age, sex, IQ, and scores on clinical measures (ADI, ADOS, Vineland, etc.) are reported in Table 1. Medication categories are detailed in the ESM.
cr4_clinical_characteristics_clinical_co.supporting_text: The final sample of autistic (N=99) and NAI (N=105) did not differ significantly... [Table 1 reports N, Sex, Age, FIQ, VIQ, PIQ, ADI social/comm/RRB, ADOS CSS, Handedness, etc.].

cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.reason: Clinical assessment measures (ADOS-2, ADI-R, Vineland, RMET, RBS, SQ) are specified with versions and described in terms of procedures.
cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.supporting_text: The Autism Diagnostic Interview-Revised (ADI-R) is a structured parent interview... The Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS) was administered... Adaptive behaviour was assessed with semi-structured parent/carer interviews using the Vineland Adaptive Behavior Scale-Second Edition.

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.reason: The meaning and direction of deviation scores (Z-scores) are explained. Thresholds for extreme deviations (|Z| > 2.6) are reported, and the clinical implications of multimodal patterns are discussed.
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: subject-specific Z -score images provide a statistical estimate of how much each individual's recorded value differs from the predicted value... Positive values (yellow) depict positive loadings onto the IC... Negative values (blue) depict negative loadings... thresholded Z-scores ( Z > |2.6| (refs. 21,37,100), corresponding to the 99.5th percentile) were compared.
